thread:
marta: heads up — saw a weird pad/unk aliasing after an HF->Redwood import this morning. chat outputs contain literal <|pad|> tokens in some quantized runs.
kevin: ugh. any reproducible minimal repro? which model + tokenizer?
marta: repro on `mosaic-7b-q4` that we converted yesterday. tokenizer looked fine at a glance but added_tokens.json has duplicate entries with different ids. snippet: 
```
// added_tokens.json
[ {"id": 50256, "special": "<|pad|>"}, {"id": 50256, "special": "<|unk|>"}, {"id": 50270, "token": "<|bos|>"} ]
```
anya: i reproduced on my laptop after pulling the converted artifacts. quantized server logs show several lines like: `decoded token 50256 -> "<|pad|>"` even when model outputs should be eos. i think id collision happened during merge step.
samir: do we have an import pipeline step that reassigns ids? maybe added_tokens merge with byte-level vocab caused index shift. can you dump tokenizer.json + vocab.json for the failing build?
marta: dumped both and attached to the build artifacts (link: https://internal.redwood/artefacts/2469/tokenizer-dump). quick diff shows HF `added_tokens.json` had explicit ids but our conversion script reindexed tokens by append order, not respecting explicit id fields.
kevin: that explains it. workaround: set pad_token / unk_token explicitly in `config.json` (model config) after import so runtime uses the explicit token index rather than assuming ordering. patch idea: when added_tokens contain `id` fields, honor them and fail conversion if we detect duplicates.
anya: confirmed workaround fixes streaming chat for my tests. but eval suite (regression-checks/eval-cleanroom) shows a small perplexity bump on LLAMA-like prompts — probably because a few prefix tokens got remapped and broke prefix caching.
samir: i'll own a conversion sanitizer. plan: add a post-import validation that checks for duplicate ids and an id->token stability matrix. also add a small unit test: import a toy vocab where added_tokens has overlapping ids and assert the importer errors.
marta: perfect. opened issue #9342 and added reproduction steps + failing logs. (link: https://internal.redwood/issue/9342)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new job queued: `eng-ml/import-sanity-check` — job id 6789.
kevin: can you also add a migration for already-imported models? some customers might be on older converted bundles. we should either re-convert or add a runtime remap layer that applies a token id override from model metadata.
samir: yes — adding a minimal runtime override is straightforward: read `token_id_overrides` in model metadata and remap on tokenizer init. will add to the PR.
anya: fyi i'll run the full eval suite once the sanitizer PR lands. if we see >0.5% quality regression, block the release. :eyes:
marta: thanks — i'll post updates in this thread and add test vectors to the issue. assigning follow-up to samir.
kevin: thanks everyone. follow-up owners: samir (fix + migration), marta (repro + issue), anya (eval).
